features.name: Feign Death
features.effect_details: You are treated as dead and cannot be targeted by enemies unless directly interacted with.

features.name: Valkyrie's Blessing
features.trigger: When you fail an ability check or attack roll
features.effect: You may reroll the result. You must use the new result.

design_notes: Novice does not have a spellcasting ability.
Novice uses fixed MP and does not scale with attributes.
All scaling mechanics (damage, healing, MP scaling, saving throws) are defined by the First Job.
Novice is designed to be adaptable, not powerful.
This level establishes player flexibility before specialization.
